info.title: PlaneMem legacy context index content and lifecycle
info.description: Source-only five-route contract for existing index directory/status/content write/delete/restore. Load this file, search/context-history OpenAPI and context-index/search schemas locally with relative paths and schema IDs preserved. No validator, generator, SDK/Mock integration or release evidence.

servers.description: Relative Gateway base; configure deployment origin/base.

x-runtime-boundaries.authorization: Bearer plus exact tenant/workspace/project and independently optional expected actor/client headers. Reads use context.read Policy/OPA, writes context.write; configured OPA replaces local Policy. POST also independently requires authenticated_client. Actual restricted-read permits restricted parent/current/input/receipt; admin alone is insufficient. Entry policy decision is audited and all five use generic actor/path rate limiting. Status write hint checks verified client and context.write or admin only, not plane ownership/deletion/expiry or a future policy decision.
x-runtime-boundaries.http: POST JSON object parsed before authentication, raw maximum1MiB, nonfatal UTF-8; malformed/nonobject/empty/overlimit is400 INVALID_JSON. No dedicated media/encoding/cache/range rejection; GET bodies/framing are not specifically rejected. Only directory GET accepts single supported URL query fields; other four reject any query. Every route parses If-Match/If-Match-Version into a safe nonnegative version, both must agree. Reads and content write ignore the parsed version; delete/restore require equality with mandatory body expected_revision. Request key is required for POST in header or body, both must match; all five bypass in-process idempotent response caching. No conditional304/412, ETag or outer revision/cursor.
x-runtime-boundaries.budgets: No dedicated complete-success byte budget, two-slot concurrency gate, whole-operation deadline or database/capture cancellation. No post-read/commit token-expiry recheck. Provider-specific timeouts do not guarantee an entire request deadline. UTF-16/finite-date/value limits remain in existing parsers, not inferred from schema maxLength alone.
x-runtime-boundaries.visibility: Directory filters visible nondeleted parent/current classification before limit; missing/hidden parent yields empty200. Status/mutation missing/hidden parent or record yields404. Index content write/replay instead uses403 for hidden parent/current or unreadable saved body. Metadata reads include expired/deleted rows; body replay excludes both current deleted/expired and expired saved content. Classification is stored index classification, not max(parent,index); source refs do not provide inherited classification or recursive validity.
x-runtime-boundaries.mutations: Delete/restore use scoped actor/client/operation/key lock and the same scoped record advisory lock as index writes, then visible parent FOR SHARE and current record FOR UPDATE. Read clock after locks, parse current status before looking up original key. SHA256(JSON.stringify({id,expected_revision,reason})) binds normalized command. Saved receipt lookup precedes new CAS/state checks; verify original command, scope, historical classification and historical revision<=current. Fresh update increments1, changes only deletion/update time/trace and commits metadata receipt atomically. No synchronization event or external memory deletion/restoration.
x-runtime-boundaries.index-write: Separate content receipt table keyed by scope/actor/client/key. Lock identity and record, visible parent/current classification before receipt lookup. Fingerprint is SHA256 of normalized object ordered id,title,snippet,revision,score,classification,rank_source,expires_at,source_refs, preserving source order. Same key/different input409; replay validates saved normalized original and at most one added ai-memory reference, current revision>=saved, current active/unexpired and saved unexpired/readable. New write requires higher revision without classification downgrade and cannot resurrect deleted records. Expired but nondeleted current records can be replaced; fresh input can itself already be expired.
x-runtime-boundaries.capture: Only fresh index write calls configured memory.capture while holding local transaction locks, with title + two newlines + snippet and current trace. No additional restricted-read requirement for capture beyond index classification checks. Reserve one source slot even for optional provider;64 input refs with configured provider gives400 before capture. Capture checks returned scope and nonempty page_ref only, appends one ai-memory source. Optional failures silently omit it with no degraded flag; required errors abort local transaction. External success followed by DB failure can leave an orphan, and changing trace on retry can create another external page. Built-in provider uses trace-derived create_only path, reads existing body on write precondition failure, and raises MEMORY_CAPTURE_CONFLICT when content differs; this is not idempotency by the original request key.
x-runtime-boundaries.clients: SDK directory/status/mutations apply shared data parsers and scope checks; generic status envelope handling does not validate index_identity/index_permissions extras or exact empty outer sources. New machine contracts are not runtime validators. Metadata checked_at is historical on replay and current on fresh reads, never a freshness proof for external sources.

get.summary: List visible index metadata including expired and deleted entries
get.description: Defaults empty query/all state/all owner/limit25, maximum100. Match ID only with PostgreSQL lower/strpos literal substring. managed_by derives from case-sensitive plane: prefix. Deleted state wins over expiry. One materialized clock_timestamp supplies metadata and expiry filter at millisecond precision. Filter parent/scope/classification/state/ownership/query before ID COLLATE C ascending limit+1; only first limit metadata parsed, not lookahead. Page parser checks duplicate IDs/scope/state/owner/count/continuation shape but not SQL order or text matching. Canonical base64url cursor [1,sha256(binding),lastReturnedId] binds scope/restricted/trimmed case-preserving query/state/owner; page size and actor/client can change. No signed cursor, total count or cross-page snapshot.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Wire1..3 digits with no leading zero, then numeric1..100; no sign/fraction/exponent.

post.summary: Explicitly save manual index content or replay its original saved content
post.description: Strict body with manual ID/title/snippet/revision/finite score/sources. Default restricted/fts/null expiry, source extensions removed, text preserved without trimming, expiry normalized to UTC. Initial revision can be0; an existing nondeleted row requires a larger safe revision and no classification downgrade. rank_source vector/rrf is stored metadata, not proof of vector search. Parsed optional version headers are not CAS for this operation. New capture/write/receipt uses same local transaction; failures after capture do not undo external side effect. Replaying original key does not call capture; requires currently visible active/unexpired index and unexpired original saved content, and returns original revision/body/sources rather than current content. New already-expired content can succeed but later body replay is denied. No ContextItem/ContextPack or event is created.

get.summary: Read current index metadata and caller identity/permission hint
get.description: No query. Read metadata under current project/record visibility, including expired/deleted and Plane-managed records. Canonical millisecond time, safe numeric revision and derived state/owner are checked. Current index_identity and write hint are outside data; hint can be true on a Plane-managed or expired record and does not override event ownership or later policy. No title/snippet/sources, upstream fetch, original-command lookup or equality inference from current state.

post.summary: Soft-delete a manual index or replay the original deletion receipt
post.description: No URL query. Decoded path overwrites optional body.id. Require mandatory body expected_revision0..MAX_SAFE_INTEGER-1, nonblank reason trimmed after raw validation, stable key and verified client. Original metadata replay occurs after current visibility/status validation but before new CAS/deletion checks, so later restored/expired records can still replay historical deletion. Fresh delete accepts active or expired nondeleted records at exact revision and increments1. Body remains stored, external memory untouched; no event. Deleted_at and updated_at come from separate clock_timestamp evaluations and are not guaranteed equal.

post.summary: Restore a deleted manual index or replay the original restoration receipt
post.description: Same raw body/key/header/identity rules as delete; separate operation-key space. Original metadata replay precedes fresh CAS/state checks. New restore requires currently deleted exact revision, increments1 and clears deleted_at while preserving expiry/body/classification/sources. Historical output can be active or expired; restoring expired content does not make it searchable. Does not restore external sources/memory or prove current state after a later command.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required here or body.idempotency_key; if both supplied they must agree. Preserve original identity/operation/parameters/key after uncertain outcome. Delete and restore have separate key spaces, distinct from content write.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: W/"version-N" with safe nonnegative integer, leading zeros accepted, no lists/wildcard. Must agree with If-Match-Version; delete/restore also require mandatory body expected_revision equality. Reads/content write only parse it, without conditional-read/CAS behavior.

IfMatchVersion.name: If-Match-Version
IfMatchVersion.description: Digits only, leading zeros accepted, numerical value0..MAX_SAFE_INTEGER; both headers must agree. Does not replace body expected_revision on delete/restore.

Mutation.description: No identity/scope/expected_version fields. Decoded route ID overwrites optional body ID before command normalization.

ListSuccess.description: Current metadata page, possibly empty for hidden/missing parent, empty outer sources, optional data.next_cursor. No ETag or current identity hint.

StatusSuccess.description: Current metadata plus index_identity and index_permissions outside data; empty sources. No ETag or stored body.

WriteSuccess.description: HTTP200 for new write or historical content replay; complete hit and identical outer sources. No original request metadata, replayed/degraded flag, ETag or event/cursor. Outer trace is current request.

DeleteSuccess.description: Original complete deletion metadata receipt, expected_revision+1, historical deleted state and timestamps; not current state. Empty sources, current trace, no ETag.

RestoreSuccess.description: Original complete restoration metadata receipt, expected_revision+1, historical active/expired state with null deleted_at. Empty sources, current trace, no ETag.

BadInput.description: INVALID_JSON for POST raw-body/shape/size; INVALID_INPUT for unsupported/repeated/invalid queries, record ID/path encoding, plane-managed write, raw body/default/version/key/reason errors. INVALID_REQUEST_CONTEXT for malformed/disagreeing generic version headers. retryable=false. GET body/framing and media types have no dedicated rejection.

BadWrite.description: Same input errors, plus missing source slot with configured capture, required MEMORY_SCOPE_MISMATCH or MEMORY_MCP_EMPTY_RESULT/INVALID_RESULT. MEMORY_PAGE_NOT_FOUND from built-in capture conflict recovery is currently400, not404. Explicit errors retryable=false; optional capture failures inside capture try are omitted silently.

Denied.description: DENIED for scope/identity/Policy/verified writer, index restricted input/current/receipt or hidden parent; content replay also denies current deleted/expired or expired historical body. retryable=false. Lifecycle hidden records instead404.

NotFound.description: NOT_FOUND for current status or metadata mutation missing/hidden parent/current/historical classification. retryable=false. Directory does not reveal hidden parent by404; content writes use403.

Conflict.description: IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED for original key with changed normalized input; CONTEXT_INDEX_VERSION_CONFLICT for stale revision/deletion state or content downgrade/re-index of deleted record. Required capture MEMORY_CAPTURE_CONFLICT for trace-path different content or propagated MEMORY_MCP_PRECONDITION_FAILED can also409. retryable=false; an error is not proof of no external capture.

InvalidStored.description: SEARCH_RESULT_INVALID for malformed stored metadata/current/saved receipt, including unsafe revision, dates/state and original request integrity; retryable=false. Unwrapped status identity parser failure becomes INTERNAL_ERROR500 retryable=true. Other unexpected command errors use the same generic500.

Unavailable.description: CONTEXT_PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE for missing database, SQL failure or non-ContractError in mutation transaction; retryable=true. WORKBENCH_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE/AUDIT_PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE also503. Some post-update receipt parser failures are caught as503, not uniformly500; transaction callback rolls back on throw.

WriteUnavailable.description: Same persistence/auth/audit503; required absent provider MEMORY_PROVIDER_OFF retryable=false, configured but disabled MemoryServiceAdapter emits the same code with retryable=true. Required non-ContractError capture failure maps CONTEXT_PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE retryable=true. MEMORY_MCP_ERROR/TOOL_ERROR retryable=false; MEMORY_MCP_UNAVAILABLE retains provider retryability (request failure/HTTP>=500 true, other non-OK HTTP false). Optional provider absence/error yields successful content without an added source, except the pre-capture source-slot check still fails400.
